match.reason: The new point is about placing paragraphs and images together in multimodal texts such as reports, websites and picture books, but the bank points cover comparing two written texts in an integrated essay and crafting figurative language within a single text, so neither teaches the same idea.

draft.title: Integrating words and images
card: In many texts, words and images are placed together on purpose. Reports, websites and picture books all do this.
an image can make the words clearer. A diagram beside a paragraph on how a dam works shows the parts the words describe.
an image can add something the words do not say. A picture book line may say a boy is fine, while the picture shows him hiding.
Placement matters. An image next to the paragraph it relates to, with a caption, helps the reader link the two.
draft.remember: Words and images are placed together so each can explain or add to the other.

a.q: A report paragraph describes how a wind turbine makes power. Beside it is a labelled diagram of the turbine. What does the diagram do?
opts: Makes the words clearer by showing the parts described
Adds a new idea that the paragraph does not mention
Replaces the paragraph so the words are not needed
Gives the reader an opinion about wind power
a.why: The diagram shows the parts the paragraph describes, so it explains the words. It does not add a new idea or replace the paragraph, because the two work together.
a.clue: Does the diagram show the same thing as the words or something new?

b.q: In a picture book, the words say Priya waved goodbye with a smile. The picture shows her tightly gripping her bag, with her eyes lowered. What do the words and image do together?
opts: The image extends the words by hinting she feels nervous
The image explains the words by showing her smile
The image repeats the words so nothing new is added
The image is unrelated to the words on the page
b.why: The image shows something the words do not say, that Priya may be nervous. That extends the meaning. It does not simply explain the words, because the picture adds a different feeling from the smile.
b.clue: Does the picture say the same thing as the words, or more?

a.best: Makes the words clearer by showing the parts described

b.best: The image extends the words by hinting she feels nervous
